edges: Nicholas Marcellus Hentz first described the species Zygoballus sexpunctatus in 1845.
George and Elizabeth Peckham renamed the species to Zygoballus sexpunctatus in 1888.
The original specimen of Zygoballus sexpunctatus was collected in North Carolina.
Zygoballus sexpunctatus is found in Florida Sand Pine scrub.
Male Zygoballus sexpunctatus exhibits elaborate courtship displays.
Zygoballus sexpunctatus is similar in appearance to Zygoballus rufipes.
